summary: US military executed a major strike wave against Iranian military infrastructure across multiple provinces, targeting coastal surveillance, air defenses, naval assets, missile and drone storage, and IRGC units responsible for recent attacks on US forces in Jordan. Iran's air defenses engaged threats over Hormozgan while explosions struck Bandar Abbas, Qeshm, Kish, Bushehr, and Khuzestan; the IRGC Aerospace commander directly threatened Gulf Arab states and Kuwaiti infrastructure came under attack. Simultaneously, IDF eliminated a Hezbollah drone cell in southern Lebanon, Iranian missiles targeted US facilities in Erbil, and Iranian leadership issued a 48-hour diplomatic ultimatum warning of all-out war.
key_points: US strikes hit Iranian coastal surveillance, air defense, naval, missile/drone sites, and IRGC forces across Bandar Abbas, Qeshm, Kish, Bushehr, Khuzestan. (Source: @asafroz/51636)
Iranian air defenses repelled attack on Hormozgan; Hormozgan governor confirmed US strike on Qeshm Island at 3:40 AM with no casualties. (Source: @presstv/199346)
IRGC Aerospace Commander Majid Mousavi warned Gulf Arab rulers to take Iran's final warning seriously. (Source: @pkpoi/143326)
At least four Iranian attacks on US forces in Jordan last week injured dozens of US soldiers and damaged helicopters. (Source: @N12chat/218008)
IDF Commando Brigade and IAF killed Hezbollah operatives piloting drone near Kfar Tebnit, southern Lebanon. (Source: @manniefabian/58803)
Iranian missile and drone barrage hit Kurdistan Region (Erbil, Sulaymaniyah, Duhok) targeting US bases, Mossad, NATO sites. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/378856)
Mojtaba Khamenei gave US 48 hours to return to diplomacy or face all-out war with unforgettable lessons. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93712)
Explosions in Kuwait near Iraqi border; attacks on Kuwaiti electricity and water facilities reported. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/76812)

points: US military completed a wave of strikes targeting Iranian coastal surveillance, air defense, naval capabilities, missile and drone storage sites, and IRGC forces responsible for July 17 attacks on US forces in Jordan, per US announcement. (Source: @asafroz/51636)

Iranian air defenses reportedly repelled an attack on Hormozgan city, while unconfirmed explosions were heard in Bandar Abbas, Bandar Lengeh, Qeshm Island, Kish Island, Bushehr, and Khuzestan province; Hormozgan governor confirmed US attack on Qeshm at 3:40 AM with no casualties. (Sources: @naya_foriraq/84093, @SharghDaily/172947, @presstv/199346, @VahidOnline/77258, @New_security8200/202750, @New_security8200/202753)

Mojtaba Khamenei, described as third declared leader, stated US violation of understandings proves US signature worthless, accused US of warmongering, and warned of "unforgettable lessons" from Iran and Resistance Axis. (Sources: @yediotnews25/132829, @VahidOnline/77246)
